body.prompt: Present the same single black steel awl with hemp-cord wrapped wooden handle on a completely plain uniformly light gray studio backdrop. The handle occupies two sevenths of its overall length; the four-sided black steel spike occupies five sevenths and gradually tapers along its entire length to a slender sharp point. Preserve materials, horizontal side view, lighting and total object proportions. All background space above and below the tool is flat uninterrupted light gray.
